title: fix(cli): keep nested sections in filtered docs
author: guus6457

gist.summary: Fixed `polli docs` heading filters so a matching section includes its nested subsections up to the next peer or ancestor heading, without duplicating nested matches. Queries such as `polli docs "MCP Servers"` now retain client setup and authentication guidance, including the Claude Code subsection. Preamble exclusion, fenced examples, and body-match fallback remain intact. Bumped `@pollinations/cli` from 0.1.50 to 0.1.51.
